metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2013 · The Great Gatsby
metas.description: A writer and wall street trader, Nick Carraway, finds himself drawn to the past and lifestyle of his mysterious millionaire neighbor, Jay Gatsby, amid the riotous parties of the Jazz Age.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2011 · Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A middle-aged husband's life changes dramatically when his wife asks him for a divorce. He seeks to rediscover his manhood with help from new acquaintance Jacob, who teaches him to pick up women at bars.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2016 · Passengers
metas.description: A malfunction in a sleeping pod on a spacecraft traveling to a distant colony planet wakes one passenger 90 years early.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2017 · The Shape of Water
metas.description: At a top secret research facility in the 1960s, a lonely janitor forms a unique relationship with an amphibious creature that is being held in captivity.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2010 · Easy A
metas.description: When Olive lies to her best friend about losing her virginity to one of the college boys, a girl overhears their conversation. Soon, her story spreads across the entire school like wildfire.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2012 · Les Misérables
metas.description: In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who, for decades, has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter. The decision changes their lives forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2012 · Pitch Perfect
metas.description: Beca, a freshman at Barden University, is cajoled into joining The Bellas, her school's all-girls singing group. Injecting some much needed energy into their repertoire, The Bellas take on their male rivals in a campus competition.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2016 · Me Before You
metas.description: A girl in a small town forms an unlikely bond with a recently-paralyzed man she's taking care of.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2015 · The Lobster
metas.description: In a dystopian near future, according to the laws of The City, single people are taken to The Hotel, where they are obliged to find a romantic partner in 45 days or they're transformed into beasts and sent off into The Woods.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2015 · The Age of Adaline
metas.description: An ageless woman meets someone who reawakens her passion for life and romance.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2010 · Blue Valentine
metas.description: A couple cannot halt the downward spiral of their marriage.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2013 · Blue Jasmine
metas.description: A New York socialite, deeply troubled and in denial, arrives in San Francisco to impose upon her sister. She looks like a million dollars but isn't bringing money, peace or love.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2016 · Allied
metas.description: In 1942, a Canadian intelligence officer in North Africa encounters a female French Resistance fighter on a deadly mission behind enemy lines. When they reunite in London, their relationship is tested by the pressures of war.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2011 · One Day
metas.description: After spending the night together on the eve of their college graduation, Dexter and Emma are shown each year on the same date to see where they are in their lives. They are sometimes together, and sometimes not.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2014 · Love, Rosie
metas.description: Rosie and Alex have been best friends since they were 5, so they couldn't possibly be right for each other--or could they? When it comes to love, life and making the right choices, these two are their own worst enemies.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2013 · The Spectacular Now
metas.description: A hard-partying high school senior's philosophy on life changes when he meets the not-so-typical "nice girl."

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2010 · Remember Me
metas.description: A romantic drama centred on two new lovers: Tyler, whose parents have split in the wake of his brother's suicide, and Ally, who lives each day to the fullest since witnessing her mother's murder.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2018 · Phantom Thread
metas.description: Set in 1950s London, Reynolds Woodcock is a renowned dressmaker whose fastidious life is disrupted by a young, strong-willed woman, Alma, who becomes his muse and lover.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2010 · Never Let Me Go
metas.description: The lives of three friends, from their early school days into young adulthood, when the reality of the world they live in comes knocking.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2015 · Brooklyn
metas.description: An Irish immigrant lands in 1950s Brooklyn, where she quickly falls into a romance with a local. When her past catches up with her, however, she must choose between two countries and the lives that exist within.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2015 · Carol
metas.description: An aspiring photographer develops an intimate relationship with an older woman in 1950s New York.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2016 · The Edge of Seventeen
metas.description: High-school life gets even more unbearable for Nadine when her best friend, Krista, starts dating her older brother.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2010 · It's Kind of a Funny Story
metas.description: A clinically-depressed teenager gets a new start after he checks himself into an adult psychiatric ward.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2017 · The Big Sick
metas.description: Pakistan-born comedian Kumail Nanjiani and grad student Emily Gardner fall in love but struggle as their cultures clash. When Emily contracts a mysterious illness, Kumail finds himself forced to face her feisty parents, his family...

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2018 · To All the Boys I've Loved Before
metas.description: A teenage girl's secret love letters are exposed and wreak havoc on her love life.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2014 · I Origins
metas.description: A molecular biologist and his laboratory partner uncover evidence that may fundamentally change society as we know it.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2010 · The Kids Are All Right
metas.description: Two children conceived by artificial insemination bring their biological father into their non-traditional family life.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2018 · Love, Simon
metas.description: Simon Spier keeps a huge secret from his family, his friends and all of his classmates: he's gay. When that secret is threatened, Simon must face everyone and come to terms with his identity.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2011 · The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel
metas.description: British retirees travel to India to take up residence in what they believe is a newly restored hotel. Less luxurious than advertised, the Marigold Hotel nevertheless slowly begins to charm in unexpected ways.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2012 · Frances Ha
metas.description: A New York woman apprentices for a dance company and throws herself headlong into her dreams, even as the possibility of realizing them dwindles.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2010 · Submarine
metas.description: 15-year-old Oliver Tate has two objectives: to lose his virginity before his next birthday, and to extinguish the flame between his mother and an ex-lover who has resurfaced in her life.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2019 · Five Feet Apart
metas.description: Stella spends most of her time in the hospital as a cystic fibrosis patient. Her life is full of routines, boundaries and self-control -- all of which get put to the test when she meets Will, a charming boy who has the same illness.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2010 · Biutiful
metas.description: A man dying of cancer tries his best to leave the world on his own terms.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2011 · Jane Eyre
metas.description: A mousy governess who softens the heart of her employer soon discovers that he's hiding a terrible secret.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2010 · Beginners
metas.description: Oliver, a graphic designer, is attracted to a free-spirited and unpredictable Anna. Memories of his father encourage him to open himself up to the potential of a true and long-lasting relationship.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2016 · Paterson
metas.description: A quiet observation of the triumphs and defeats of daily life, along with the poetry evident in its smallest details.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2012 · Stuck in Love.
metas.description: An acclaimed writer, his ex-wife, and their teenaged children come to terms with the complexities of love in all its forms over the course of one tumultuous year.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2015 · The Longest Ride
metas.description: Sophia and Luke make an unexpected and fateful connection with Ira, a 90-year-old man, when they save him from a car crash. Ira's memories of his own decades-long romance with his beloved wife deeply inspire the young couple.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2012 · The Words
metas.description: A writer at the peak of his literary success discovers the steep price he must pay for stealing another man's work.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2012 · Rust and Bone
metas.description: Put in charge of his young son, Alain leaves Belgium for Antibes to live with his sister and her husband as a family. Alain's bond with Stephanie, a killer whale trainer, grows deeper after Stephanie suffers a horrible accident.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2019 · Downton Abbey
metas.description: The Crawleys and their servants prepare to host King George V and Queen Mary at Downton Abbey.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2013 · Enough Said
metas.description: A divorced woman who decides to pursue the man she's interested in learns he's her new friend's ex-husband.
